name: Heart Up My Sleeves
tagline: Detachable statement sleeves that restyle existing outfits
excerpt: Heart Up My Sleeves, Riya Khattar's detachable-sleeves label, won ₹25 lakh in the first episode of Shark Tank India.
content:
Heart Up My Sleeves sells detachable statement sleeves, plus capes and brooches, so that women can change the look of clothes they already own. Founder Riya Khattar started it during the pandemic and pitched it in the very first episode of Shark Tank India, aired on 20 December 2021.

She left with ₹25 lakh in funding, as YourStory reported. The stake and the investing sharks were not confirmed by an outlet we could check, so we leave them out.

We could not find a filing-based report of the company's revenue or funding since the show.

shark_tank.pitch_summary: Riya Khattar pitched detachable sleeves as a way to restyle existing outfits. She won ₹25 lakh in funding.

faq.q: Did Heart Up My Sleeves get a deal on Shark Tank India?

lessons: Our analysis: a product that extends the life of clothes people already own fits both thrift and sustainability trends.
notes: BELOW PUBLISHING BAR (no sourced ask). Ask (₹25 lakh for 10% per Wikipedia; 20% per a Century Financial blog) and final 30% with Anupam Mittal and Vineeta Singh appear only on Wikipedia/blogs.
